name: @office/host-gateway
description: Office production gateway composition (OFF-DEPLOY): the server-side runtime behind the browser host — the pg pool over the caller-supplied connection string, the forward-only migrator over the ordered union of every landed migration directory (persistence foundation, events ledger + outbox, organization + project domains), the canonical PostgreSQL path (tenants/organizations/projects through the landed domain repositories and their own lifecycle command services, audit events appended to the real event ledger + outbox inside the same transaction), the @office/web session/view-model/command surface driven server-side over the deterministic seeded reference world (createWebSession + seedOfficeWorld + openWebDataPlane + projectWorkspace + controlTowerView + the evidence walkers, composed through @office/web's public root entry ONLY), and the REAL A8 action gateway (@office/actions createActionGateway) with the approval-gated workflow decision routed through the workflow-engine-backed approval authority — one composition, deterministic injected clock/id suppliers, typed Results everywhere, fail-closed parsing of every input. It is the ONLY workspace package apps/host may import besides @office/web: all SQL lives here (the host stays structurally database-free; the architecture gate enforces it).
